words.en: Suicide is the act of deliberately killing oneself.

words.ex: He will restore the old bike.
words.ex_cn: 他将修复这辆旧自行车。
words.en: To restore something means to bring it back to its original condition or to a state of health, efficiency, or good management.

words.ex: I will arrange a meeting for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我将为明天安排一次会议。
words.en: If you arrange an event or meeting, you make plans for it to happen.

words.ex: He will flee from the burning house.
words.ex_cn: 他会从着火的房子里逃走。
words.en: If you flee from something or someone, you leave them quickly because you are afraid of them or because you do not want to be involved with them.

words.ex: He goes to the gym every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身房。
words.en: A gym is a place equipped for physical exercise and training, especially for athletes or for people who want to keep fit.

words.tr: phrase. 区分；留出；使与众不同
words.ex: His kindness sets him apart from others.
words.ex_cn: 他的善良使他与众不同。
words.en: To distinguish someone or something as different from others; to reserve or allocate something for a specific purpose.

words.ex: I have an appointment with my doctor at 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我下午三点有个医生的约会。
words.en: An appointment is a formal arrangement to meet or visit someone at a particular time, especially for a purpose connected with their work or official position.

words.ex: The children's laughter filled the room.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们的笑声充满了房间。
words.en: The sound of people laughing, especially when it is loud and continuous.

words.ex: The noise was intolerable.
words.ex_cn: 这噪音无法忍受。
words.en: If you describe something as intolerable, you mean that it is so bad or extreme that no one can bear it or tolerate it.

words.tr: adj. 难以忍受的；不能容忍的
words.ex: The heat was unbearable.
words.ex_cn: 天气热得难以忍受。
words.en: If you describe something as unbearable, you mean that it is so unpleasant, painful, or upsetting that you feel unable to accept it or deal with it.

words.tr:
v. 点击；
n. 咔哒声；
words.ex: Click the button to start the game.
words.ex_cn: 点击按钮开始游戏。
words.en: To make a short, sharp sound, or to press a button on a computer mouse or other device to select something on a screen.

words.ex: This house has a modern design.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子具有现代的设计。
words.en: Modern means relating to the present time, for example the present decade or present century.

words.tr: adj. 讨厌的； v. “annoy”的现在分词；
words.ex: The loud noise is annoying.
words.ex_cn: 这噪音很讨厌。
words.en: Something that is annoying makes you feel fairly angry and impatient.

words.ex: The loud music annoys me.
words.ex_cn: 嘈杂的音乐让我烦恼。
words.en: If someone or something annoys you, it makes you fairly angry and impatient.

words.ex: The connection between the two wires is loose.
words.ex_cn: 两根电线之间的连接松了。
words.en: A connection is a relationship between two things, people, or groups.

words.tr:
n. 曲调；调子；
v. 调整；调音；
words.ex: He hummed a happy tune while walking.
words.ex_cn: 他走路时哼着一首欢快的曲调。
words.en: A tune is a series of musical notes that are pleasant to listen to. It can also refer to adjusting something so that it works or looks better.

words.ex: He forgot his password and could not log in.
words.ex_cn: 他忘记了密码，无法登录。
words.en: A password is a secret word or phrase that you must know in order to be allowed to enter a place or to use a computer system.

words.tr:
n. 家庭；
adj. 家庭的；
words.ex: This household has three children.
words.ex_cn: 这个家庭有三个孩子。
words.en: A household is all the people in a family or group who live together in a house.

words.tr: phrase. 对…上瘾；对…非常着迷
words.ex: He is hooked on video games.
words.ex_cn: 他沉迷于电子游戏。
words.en: To be very interested in or very involved with something, often to the point of being addicted to it.

words.tr: phrase. 在...之上；加之；紧接着
words.ex: The book is on top of the table.
words.ex_cn: 书在桌子上面。
words.en: In addition to; in control of or fully informed about something.

words.ex: He felt intense pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到剧烈的疼痛。
words.en: If you describe an activity as intense, you mean that it is very serious and concentrated, and often involves doing a great deal in a short time.

words.tr:
adv. 全球性地；
adj. 全球性的；
words.ex: The news spread worldwide overnight.
words.ex_cn: 这则新闻一夜之间传遍全球。
words.en: Something that is worldwide exists or happens in all parts of the world.

words.ex: The wind scatter the leaves everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 风把树叶吹得四处分散。
words.en: To scatter means to throw or drop things over a wide area in an irregular way, or to cause a group of people or animals to move apart in different directions.

words.ex: The children ran outwards from the house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们从房子里向外跑。
words.en: Moving or facing away from the center or a particular point; towards the outside.

words.ex: The wind blew inwards through the open door.
words.ex_cn: 风从敞开的门吹向内地。
words.en: If something moves or faces inwards, it moves or faces towards the inside or centre of something.

words.tr: n. 车辆；交通工具；媒介；
words.ex: The vehicle stopped at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在红灯前停了下来。
words.en: A vehicle is a machine such as a car, bus, or truck which has an engine and is used to carry people or goods from place to place.

words.ex: He is a liar because he told a lie.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个骗子，因为他撒了谎。
words.en: A liar is someone who tells lies.

words.ex: His denial of the mistake made everyone angry.
words.ex_cn: 他否认错误，让所有人都生气了。
words.en: A denial is a statement that something is not true or does not exist.

words.tr:
adv. 在夜里；突然；
adj. 整晚的；
words.ex: The baby slept overnight in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿整夜睡在小床上。
words.en: If something happens overnight, it happens during the night or for the period of one night. It can also mean happening very quickly or suddenly.

words.tr: phrase. 大体上；基本上；总的来说
words.ex: On the whole, the movie was good.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，这部电影不错。
words.en: You use on the whole to indicate that what you are saying is true in general but may not be true in every case, or that you are giving a general opinion or summary of something.

words.ex: He gave a reasonable answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个合理的回答。
words.en: Fair and sensible; not excessive or extreme.

words.ex: There is a tendency for people to use phones before bed.
words.ex_cn: 人们在睡觉前使用手机是一种趋势。
words.en: A tendency is a likelihood of behaving in a particular way or going in a particular direction, which is often bad or undesirable.

words.ex: He overlooked the mistake in the report.
words.ex_cn: 他忽略了报告中的错误。
words.en: If you overlook a fact or problem, you do not notice it, or do not realize how important it is.

words.tr: n. 疯子；拾坚果的人; n. （Nutter）人名；（英）纳特；（德）努特
words.ex: He is a nutter who talks to himself.
words.ex_cn: 他是个自言自语的疯子。
words.en: If you refer to someone as a nutter, you mean that they are mad or that their behaviour is very strange.

words.tr: n. 书呆子；蠢货；电脑迷
words.ex: He is a nerd who loves math and computers.
words.ex_cn: 他是个热爱数学和电脑的书呆子。
words.en: A nerd is a person who is extremely interested in one subject, especially computers, and knows a lot of facts about it.

words.tr:
n. 纸片；
v. 滑倒；溜走；
words.ex: She found a slip of paper on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她在桌子上发现了一张纸片。
words.en: If you slip, you accidentally slide and lose your balance.

words.ex: The horror of the dark made her scream.
words.ex_cn: 对黑暗的恐惧让她尖叫。
words.en: A feeling of great fear, shock, or disgust.

words.tr:
n. 情节；小块用地；
v. 绘图；
words.ex: The plot of the movie was very exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的情节非常精彩。
words.en: A plot is a secret plan by a group of people to do something that is illegal or wrong, especially against a person or a government. It can also refer to the main events of a play, novel, movie, or similar work, devised and presented by the writer as an interrelated sequence. Additionally, a plot can be a small piece of land that is used or intended for a specific purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 据某人所知；在某人认知范围内
words.ex: To my knowledge, he has never been late for school.
words.ex_cn: 据我所知，他上学从未迟到过。
words.en: As far as one knows or is aware.

words.ex: Needless to say, he was late again.
words.ex_cn: 不用说，他又迟到了。
words.en: used to say that something is so obvious that it does not need to be mentioned

words.tr: phrase. v. 引起；唤起；使出现
words.ex: The story can call forth strong feelings in people.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事能唤起人们的强烈情感。
words.en: To cause something to happen or to evoke a particular reaction or response.

words.ex: He picked up an axe to chop wood.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起一把斧子去砍柴。
words.en: An axe is a tool used for chopping wood, typically consisting of a heavy metal blade fixed at a right angle at the end of a long handle. As a verb, to axe means to dismiss or reduce something drastically.

words.ex: The child imitates her mother's voice.
words.ex_cn: 孩子模仿她妈妈的声音。
words.en: If you imitate someone, you copy what they do or produce.

words.ex: He sweats heavily after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后大量出汗。
words.en: Sweat is the salty liquid that comes out through the skin when you are hot, ill, or afraid.

words.ex: He dried his hands with a towel.
words.ex_cn: 他用毛巾擦干手。
words.en: A towel is a piece of thick soft cloth that you use to dry yourself with.

words.ex: He practices pole-vault every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午练习撑杆跳高。
words.en: The sport or activity of jumping over a high bar with the aid of a long flexible pole.

words.ex: The bank keeps money in a vault.
words.ex_cn: 银行把钱存放在金库里。
words.en: A vault is an arched structure that forms a ceiling or roof, or a room, especially in a church, that has an arched ceiling or roof. It can also refer to a jump over something using your hands or a pole to push yourself off the ground.

words.ex: She walked with grace across the stage.
words.ex_cn: 她优雅地走过舞台。
words.en: Grace is the quality of being pleasant, polite, and dignified, or a period of time allowed for something to be done.

words.ex: The gymnast flips in the air and lands softly.
words.ex_cn: 体操运动员在空中翻转并轻柔落地。
words.en: A gymnast is a person who is trained in or skilled in gymnastics, especially competitive gymnastics.

words.tr: n. 健美运动者；锻炼肌肉者；车身制造工；车身制造商
words.ex: He is a bodybuilder who lifts weights every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名每天举重的健美运动员。
words.en: A bodybuilder is someone who does exercises to develop their muscles, often as a competitive sport.

words.ex: It was a mere mistake, not intentional.
words.ex_cn: 那只是一个小小的错误，并非故意的。
words.en: You use mere to emphasize how unimportant or inadequate something is, in comparison to the general situation you are describing.

words.ex: The child loves to play with fantasy stories about dragons.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子喜欢玩关于龙的幻想故事。
words.en: A fantasy is a pleasant situation or event that you imagine, which is unlikely to happen.

words.ex: There are numerous books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有许多书。
words.en: If people or things are numerous, they exist or are present in large numbers.

words.ex: The children felt excitement before the birthday party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在生日派对前感到兴奋。
words.en: A feeling of great enthusiasm and eagerness.

words.ex: He has a passion for painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画充满激情。
words.en: A very strong feeling of love, hate, anger, enthusiasm, etc.

words.ex: The problem recurs every week.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题每周都会再次出现。
words.en: If something recurs, it happens again, either once or several times.

words.ex: He outran the dog and reached the finish line first.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得比狗快，第一个到达了终点线。
words.en: If you outrun someone, you run faster than they do, and therefore are able to escape from them or to arrive somewhere before they do.

words.ex: The locomotive pulled the train down the track.
words.ex_cn: 机车拉着火车沿着轨道行驶。
words.en: A locomotive is a powered rail vehicle used for pulling trains.

words.ex: The price of oil soared last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月石油价格骤升。
words.en: To rise or increase dramatically in amount or level.

words.ex: The eagle flies high above the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 鹰在山上面高飞。
words.en: A large bird of prey with a massive hooked bill and long broad wings, known for its keen sight and powerful soaring flight.

words.ex: His opinion coincides with mine.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点与我的一致。
words.en: If one event coincides with another, they happen at the same time.

words.ex: His opinion coincides with mine.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点与我的一致。
words.en: To happen at the same time as something else or to be the same or very similar.

words.tr: adj. 构成核心的；顽固的；赤裸裸的
words.ex: The hard-core members of the team never miss practice.
words.ex_cn: 团队的核心成员从不缺席训练。
words.en: Someone who is hard-core is very committed to a particular activity or belief, often to an extreme degree.

words.tr:
n. 核；核心；重点；
adj. 核心的；
words.ex: The core of the apple is not edible.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的核心不能吃。
words.en: The central or most important part of something.

words.ex: He is a realist who plans for the future.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个为未来做计划的现实主义者。
words.en: A realist is someone who recognizes and accepts the true nature of a situation and tries to deal with it in a practical way.

words.ex: Her motto is 'Never give up.'
words.ex_cn: 她的座右铭是‘永不放弃’。
words.en: A motto is a short sentence or phrase that expresses a rule for sensible behavior, especially a way of behaving in a particular situation.

words.ex: He does weightlifting every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上举重。
words.en: Weightlifting is a sport in which competitors lift heavy weights, either as a single lift or as a combination of lifts, in order to demonstrate their strength.

words.tr:
adj. 交替的；轮流的；间隔的；
v. （使）交替；（使）轮流；
words.ex: We take alternate days off work.
words.ex_cn: 我们隔天休息一次。
words.en: If something alternates between two things, it repeatedly changes from one to the other and back again.

words.tr:
n. 教练；长途客运汽车；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: The coach taught the team how to win.
words.ex_cn: 教练教球队如何获胜。
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a particular sport. It also refers to a large, comfortable bus that carries passengers on long journeys.

words.ex: His dedication to teaching helped many students succeed.
words.ex_cn: 他对教学的奉献帮助了许多学生取得成功。
words.en: The act of dedicating or the state of being dedicated; commitment.

words.ex: He dedicates his time to helping poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他致力于帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: If you dedicate yourself to something, you give all your attention and effort to it.

words.tr: n. 令人讨厌的或繁重的工作；
words.ex: Washing dishes is a boring chore.
words.ex_cn: 洗碗是一件烦人的琐事。
words.en: A chore is a task or piece of work that is often boring or unpleasant but needs to be done regularly.

words.tr: phrase. 有一次；曾经；在某个场合
words.ex: On one occasion, he forgot his keys.
words.ex_cn: 有一次，他忘了带钥匙。
words.en: At a particular time in the past, especially when something unusual happened.

words.tr: phrase. 在两次场合；有两次
words.ex: He was late on two occasions.
words.ex_cn: 他有两次迟到了。
words.en: At two different times or events.

words.tr: phrase. 在好几次场合；多次；屡次
words.ex: He called me on several occasions to ask for help.
words.ex_cn: 他好几次打电话给我求助。
words.en: On multiple separate occasions or instances.

words.tr: adj. 徒劳的；空虚的；自负的；爱慕虚荣的
words.ex: It's vain to try to fix what can't be fixed.
words.ex_cn: 试图修复无法修复的东西是徒劳的。
words.en: If you describe someone as vain, you are critical of their extreme pride in their own beauty, intelligence, or other good qualities.

words.tr: n. 条状物；酒吧；栅栏；棒；
words.ex: He ate a chocolate bar after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一条巧克力。
words.en: A bar is a place where alcoholic drinks are served, or a long, narrow piece of metal or wood used for a particular purpose.

words.tr: v. 膨胀；使充气；夸口；吹嘘
words.ex: He tries to inflate the balloon with his mouth.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用嘴把气球吹大。
words.en: To inflate something means to cause it to increase in size by filling it with air or gas. It can also refer to increasing the amount of money in circulation, leading to a decrease in its value.

words.ex: He put a mat on the floor to keep it clean.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上放了一块垫子以保持清洁。
words.en: A mat is a piece of thick fabric or other material that is placed on a floor or other surface to protect it or to provide a soft surface to stand or sit on.

words.tr: adj. 没意识到的；不知道的；
words.ex: He was unaware of the rain until he got wet.
words.ex_cn: 他直到被淋湿了才意识到下雨了。
words.en: If you are unaware of something, you do not know about it.

words.ex: He beat his competitor in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中击败了对手。
words.en: A competitor is a person, team, or company that is competing against others, especially in business or sports.

words.ex: He showed strong emotion when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，表现出了强烈的情绪。
words.en: An emotion is a feeling such as happiness, love, fear, anger, or hatred, which can be caused by the situation that you are in or the people you are with.

words.tr:
v. 呻吟；叹息
n. 呻吟声；叹息声
words.ex: He groaned when he saw the heavy box.
words.ex_cn: 他看到那个沉重的箱子时呻吟了一声。
words.en: If you groan, you make a long, low sound because you are in pain, or because you are upset or unhappy about something.

words.tr: phrase. 对……感到羞愧；因……而内疚
words.ex: He is ashamed of his bad grades.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己糟糕的成绩感到羞愧。
words.en: To feel shame or guilt about something you have done or about a situation.

words.tr: adj．指尖的：指与手指尖端有关的。
words.ex: He is finger-tipped with the piano keys.
words.ex_cn: 他对钢琴键了如指掌。
words.en: Relating to or using the tips of the fingers.

words.ex: He does ten push-ups every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上做十个俯卧撑。
words.en: A push-up is a physical exercise performed in a prone position by raising and lowering the body using the arms.

words.ex: The plane landed on the runway.
words.ex_cn: 飞机降落在跑道上。
words.en: A runway is a strip of land where aircraft take off and land.

words.ex: The loud noise startle the bird.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音惊动了那只鸟。
words.en: If something or someone startles you, they surprise and frighten you slightly.

words.tr:
n. 包；捆
v. 捆成大包
words.ex: He tied the hay into a bale.
words.ex_cn: 他把干草捆成一捆。
words.en: A bale is a large quantity of something such as hay, paper, wool, or cloth that has been tied tightly into a rectangular shape.

words.ex: The horse eats hay every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这匹马每天早上吃干草。
words.en: Hay is grass which has been cut and dried so that it can be used to feed animals.

words.ex: The intensity of the sunlight made me wear sunglasses.
words.ex_cn: 阳光的强度让我戴上了太阳镜。
words.en: The quality of being intense, especially in terms of concentration, power, or force.

words.ex: He felt anxiety before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到忧虑。
words.en: Anxiety is a feeling of worry, nervousness, or unease about something with an uncertain outcome.

words.tr: n. 紧张；紧张局势；紧张关系；
words.ex: There was tension between the two friends after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 两人争吵后，彼此之间出现了紧张。
words.en: Tension is a feeling of worry and anxiety which makes it difficult for you to relax. It can also refer to the state of being stretched tight or the degree of tightness of a stretched string, wire, etc.

words.tr:
adj. 紧张的；拉紧的；
n. 时态；
words.ex: He felt tense before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到紧张。
words.en: If you are tense, you are anxious and nervous and cannot relax.

words.tr: phrase. 与...在一起；沿着；除此之外，还…
words.ex: He bought apples along with oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他买了苹果，还买了橙子。
words.en: in addition to someone or something else; together with someone or something else

words.ex: She decided to stretch out on the beach and enjoy the sun.
words.ex_cn: 她决定在沙滩上伸展身体，享受阳光。
words.en: To extend or lengthen one's body or a part of one's body to its full length.

words.ex: The upper shelf is too high to reach.
words.ex_cn: 上面的架子太高了，够不着。
words.en: Higher in place or position; situated above another part.

words.ex: A gentle breeze blew through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一阵微风轻轻吹过树梢。
words.en: A breeze is a gentle wind.

words.ex: The loud music deafened him.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的音乐让他耳聋了。
words.en: If a noise deafens you, it is so loud that you cannot hear anything else at the same time.

words.ex: He ran a 100-meter sprint in under 11 seconds.
words.ex_cn: 他在100米冲刺中跑出了不到11秒的成绩。
words.en: If you sprint, you run or ride as fast as you can over a short distance.

words.ex: The plane's takeoff was delayed by strong wind.
words.ex_cn: 飞机的起飞因强风而延误了。
words.en: Takeoff is the beginning of a flight, when an aircraft leaves the ground.

words.ex: She made the dance look effortless.
words.ex_cn: 她让舞蹈看起来毫不费力。
words.en: If you describe something as effortless, you mean that it is done or achieved with very little difficulty or work, often as a result of great skill.

words.ex: The motion of the ball is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 球的运动非常快。
words.en: The action or process of moving or being moved.

words.ex: The volcano had a big eruption last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周这座火山发生了大喷发。
words.en: An eruption is a sudden, often violent, outburst or discharge, such as that of a volcano, emotion, or conflict.

words.ex: The volcano erupts suddenly.
words.ex_cn: 火山突然喷发。
words.en: If a volcano erupts, it throws out smoke, fire, and melted rocks.

words.tr:
v. 重击；捶击；发撞击声
n. 重击声；重打
words.ex: He thumped the table with his fist.
words.ex_cn: 他用拳头重击了桌子。
words.en: If you thump something, you hit it hard, usually with your fist.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人恢复现实；使某人脚踏实地
words.uk: brɪŋ sʌm wʌn bæk tə ɜːθ
words.us: brɪŋ sʌm wʌn bæk tə ɜrθ
words.ex: He shouted to bring her back to earth.
words.ex_cn: 他大喊让她回到现实。
words.en: To cause someone to return to reality, often from a state of overconfidence or unrealistic optimism.

words.tr: phrase. 在想象中；在脑海里；在心灵之眼中
words.ex: In my mind's eye, I can see the house where I grew up.
words.ex_cn: 在我的脑海中，我能看见我长大的那所房子。
words.en: If you see something in your mind's eye, you imagine it and have a clear picture of it in your mind.

words.tr:
v. 拥抱；紧抱；抱有；挨着
n. 拥抱；搂抱
words.ex: She gave him a big hug when he arrived.
words.ex_cn: 他到达时，她给了他一个大大的拥抱。
words.en: To hug someone means to put your arms around them and hold them tightly, for example because you like them or are pleased to see them.

words.ex: I congratulate you on your success.
words.ex_cn: 我祝贺你取得成功。
words.en: If you congratulate someone, you express pleasure for something good that has happened to them, or you praise them for something they have achieved.

words.ex: The media reported the news quickly.
words.ex_cn: 媒介迅速报道了这则新闻。
words.en: The main means of mass communication (broadcasting, publishing, and the Internet), regarded collectively.

words.ex: The company gave sponsorship to the local sports team.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司资助了当地的体育团队。
words.en: The support given by a sponsor; the act of sponsoring.

words.tr:
n. 赞助商；
v. 赞助；
words.ex: The company is a sponsor of the football match.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司是这场足球赛的赞助商。
words.en: A sponsor is a person or organization that pays for or contributes to the costs involved in staging a sporting or artistic event in return for advertising. A sponsor can also be someone who introduces and supports a proposal for a new law.

words.ex: The road inclines sharply to the top of the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这条路陡峭地倾斜向山顶。
words.en: If you incline to a particular opinion, you have a tendency to think or behave in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 身体健康的；处于良好健康状态的
words.ex: He is in good health after the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 手术后他身体很健康。
words.en: If you are in good health, you are healthy and not suffering from any illness.

words.tr: phrase. 身体非常健康的；处于极佳健康状态的
words.ex: He is in excellent health after his recovery.
words.ex_cn: 他康复后身体非常好。
words.en: In a state of very good physical or mental well-being.

words.tr: phrase. 健康状况不佳的；身体不好的
words.ex: He is in poor health after the long illness.
words.ex_cn: 这场长期疾病后，他身体很差。
words.en: If someone is in poor health, they are not healthy and often become ill.

words.tr: n. 运动员；田径运动员；
words.ex: The athlete ran fast and won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位运动员跑得很快，赢得了比赛。
words.en: An athlete is a person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

words.ex: The movie was horrible and made me scared.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很恐怖，让我害怕。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as horrible, you mean they are very unpleasant or bad.

words.ex: He suffers from a bad cold.
words.ex_cn: 他患了重感冒。
words.en: If you suffer from an illness or from a medical condition, you are badly affected by it.

words.ex: This school uses a progressive teaching method.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校使用一种先进的教学方法。
words.en: A progressive person or idea is one that is modern and new, and is interested in change and improvement.

words.tr: phrase. 运动神经；控制肌肉运动的神经
words.ex: The motor nerve controls muscle movement.
words.ex_cn: 运动神经控制肌肉运动。
words.en: A motor nerve is a nerve that transmits impulses from the brain or spinal cord to muscles or glands, causing them to move or secrete.

words.ex: He went to school in spite of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: You use in spite of to introduce a fact which makes the rest of the statement you are making seem surprising.

words.tr:
n. 帮助；援助；
v. 帮助；协助；
words.ex: The charity provided aid to the flood victims.
words.ex_cn: 慈善机构向洪水受害者提供了帮助。
words.en: To aid someone means to help or assist them. Aid can also refer to the help or support given.

words.ex: He will install the new software on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他将在他的电脑上安装新软件。
words.en: To set up or fix in position for use or service.

words.ex: He is optimistic about the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来持乐观态度。
words.en: Someone who is optimistic is hopeful about the future or the success of something in particular.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种程度上；部分地
words.ex: He is tired to a degree.
words.ex_cn: 他有点累了。
words.en: To a degree means to some extent or in some measure.

words.ex: He was utterly surprised by the news.
words.ex_cn: 他全然没想到这个消息。
words.en: completely or totally

words.tr:
v. 使不再抱幻想；使理想破灭
n. 幻灭；理想破灭
words.ex: The bad experience disillusioned him about politics.
words.ex_cn: 这次糟糕的经历让他对政治不再抱幻想。
words.en: If a person or thing disillusions you, they make you realize that something is not as good as you thought it was.

words.tr:
n. 跛子；（身体部分或全部肢体）有缺陷的人
v. 使成瘸子；严重损坏（削弱）
words.ex: The cripple walked slowly with a cane.
words.ex_cn: 那个跛子拄着拐杖慢慢走。
words.en: If someone is crippled by an injury, it is so serious that they can never move their body properly again. A cripple is a person who is severely disabled or unable to walk because of damage to their body.

words.tr: phrase. 紧紧抓住；坚持；保持
words.ex: Please hold on to the handrail when the bus starts.
words.ex_cn: 当公共汽车启动时，请抓紧扶手。
words.en: To hold on to something means to keep it in your possession or to not let it go, often because it is valuable or important to you.

words.ex: He felt miserable after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到很悲惨。
words.en: If you are miserable, you are very unhappy.

words.ex: He likes to study philosophy in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间学习哲学。
words.en: Philosophy is the study or creation of theories about basic things such as the nature of existence, knowledge, and thought, or about how people should live.

words.ex: He dismissed her advice and walked away.
words.ex_cn: 他不理会她的建议，走开了。
words.en: If you dismiss someone, you send them away or allow them to leave.

words.ex: The cow has two long horns.
words.ex_cn: 这头牛有两只长角。
words.en: A horn is a pointed projection on the head of various animals, consisting of a core of bone surrounded by a sheath of keratin, or a device for making a loud warning noise.

words.ex: He walks with a crutch after his accident.
words.ex_cn: 他事故后拄着拐杖走路。
words.en: A crutch is a stick with a handle and a part that fits under the arm, which you use to support your body if you are having difficulty in walking because of a foot or leg injury.

words.tr:
n. 捆；束；包
v. 匆匆送走
words.ex: He bought a bundle of newspapers.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一捆报纸。
words.en: A bundle is a number of things that are tied or wrapped together so that they can be carried or stored easily.

words.tr:
v. （使）倾斜；（使）偏向
n. 倾斜；企图
words.ex: The boy tilt the cup and spill the water.
words.ex_cn: 男孩把杯子倾斜，水洒了出来。
words.en: If you tilt an object or if it tilts, it moves into a sloping position with one end or side higher than the other.

words.ex: There is a five-minute interval between the two classes.
words.ex_cn: 两节课之间有五分钟的间隔。
words.en: An interval is a period of time between two events or dates.

words.tr: v. 砰地关上；猛地一动；抨击
words.ex: He slammed the door angrily.
words.ex_cn: 他生气地把门砰地关上。
words.en: If you slam a door or window, or if it slams, it shuts noisily and with great force.

words.ex: The children are merry on Christmas day.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在圣诞节那天很开心。
words.en: If you describe someone's character or behavior as merry, you mean that they are happy and cheerful.

words.ex: Water can penetrate the soil slowly.
words.ex_cn: 水可以慢慢渗透进土壤。
words.en: To penetrate means to enter or pass through something, especially when this is difficult or when it is not obvious how to do it.

words.ex: The mechanic tightened the bolt with a wrench.
words.ex_cn: 机械师用扳手拧紧了螺栓。
words.en: A bolt is a type of fastener consisting of a threaded pin or rod with a head at one end, designed to be inserted through holes in assembled parts and tightened by a nut from the other end. It can also refer to a sudden dash or run, or to eat food quickly and without chewing.

words.ex: Honesty is a good trait.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一种好的特性。
words.en: A trait is a particular characteristic, quality, or tendency that someone or something has.

words.tr:
n. 溢出；
v. 泛滥；
words.ex: The rain caused an overflow of the river.
words.ex_cn: 雨水导致河水溢出。
words.en: If a liquid or a river overflows, it flows over the edges of the container or place it is in.

words.ex: His selfishness made his friends leave him.
words.ex_cn: 他的自私使他的朋友们离开了他。
words.en: If you say that someone is selfish, you mean that they care only about themselves, and not about other people.

words.ex: He prays every morning before breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃早餐前祈祷。
words.en: To pray means to speak to God in order to give thanks or to ask for something.

words.ex: He has awareness of the environmental problems.
words.ex_cn: 他意识到环境问题。
words.en: Knowledge or perception of a situation or fact.

words.ex: His main shortcoming is being late often.
words.ex_cn: 他的主要缺点是经常迟到。
words.en: A shortcoming is a fault or a failure to meet a certain standard, which means a person or thing is not as good as they should be.

words.tr:
adj. 微型的；
n. 微型画；小型模型；
words.ex: He bought a miniature car for his collection.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的收藏买了一辆微型汽车。
words.en: A miniature is a very small detailed painting, often a portrait. It can also refer to a small-scale model or representation of something.

words.tr:
n. 兽群；
v. 放牧；
words.ex: The herd of cows walked slowly to the pasture.
words.ex_cn: 一群牛缓缓走向牧场。
words.en: A herd is a large group of animals of one kind that live together.

words.tr: 短语，用于表示一群（通常用于牛、羊、大象等动物），如：一群牛 a herd of cattle
words.ex: A herd of cows is walking near the farm.
words.ex_cn: 一群牛正在农场附近行走。
words.en: A group of animals, especially cattle or elephants, that live, feed, or move together.

words.ex: The child rides a pony in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在公园里骑小马。
words.en: A pony is a small horse.

words.ex: The little girl plays with a doll.
words.ex_cn: 小女孩在玩一个洋娃娃。
words.en: A doll is a child's toy which looks like a small person or baby.

words.tr: adj. 被紧迫追赶的；被催逼的；处境困难的
words.ex: He is hard-pressed to finish the work on time.
words.ex_cn: 他很难按时完成这项工作。
words.en: If someone is hard-pressed, they are under a lot of pressure and are finding it very difficult to do what they should do.

words.ex: The children are playing in the playroom.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在游戏室里玩耍。
words.en: A playroom is a room in a house that is set aside for children to play in.

words.tr: n. 假小子，行为似男孩的顽皮姑娘
words.ex: She is a tomboy who loves playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 她是个喜欢踢足球的假小子。
words.en: A girl who enjoys rough, noisy activities traditionally associated with boys.

words.ex: It's ironic that the fire station burned down.
words.ex_cn: 消防站着火了，这真是讽刺。
words.en: If you say that it is ironic that something happens, you mean that it is odd or amusing because it involves a contrast or is the opposite of what you would expect.

words.ex: The mechanical toy moves with batteries.
words.ex_cn: 这个机械玩具用电池驱动。
words.en: Relating to machines or machinery; operated by or involving a machine or machines.

words.ex: He converts old paper into new notebooks.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧纸张转换成新笔记本。
words.en: To change something into a different form or to change someone's beliefs, especially their religious beliefs.

words.tr: v. 狂吃暴饮；大吃大喝；大量消耗
words.ex: He guzzles soda every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都大口喝苏打水。
words.en: If you guzzle something, you drink it quickly and greedily.

words.tr: adj. 耗油的；高油耗的；吞油的
words.ex: He drives a gas-guzzling truck.
words.ex_cn: 他开一辆耗油的卡车。
words.en: Using or consuming a large amount of fuel, especially in a way that is considered wasteful.

words.tr: n. 运动型多用途车（Sports Utility Vehicle）
words.ex: He drives a big suv to carry his family.
words.ex_cn: 他开一辆大SUV来载他的家人。
words.en: A sport utility vehicle (SUV) is a vehicle that combines the towing capacity of a pickup truck with the passenger-carrying space of a minivan or station wagon.

words.tr:
n. 杂交种；混合物；
adj. 混合的；
words.ex: The corn hybrid grows faster than the old type.
words.ex_cn: 这种玉米杂交种比旧品种长得更快。
words.en: A hybrid is a plant or animal that has been produced from two different types of plant or animal, especially to get better characteristics. It can also refer to something that is a mixture of two different things.

words.tr: adj. 多变量的（等于 multivariate）；多元的
words.ex: He is learning multivariable calculus this semester.
words.ex_cn: 他这学期正在学习多元微积分。
words.en: Involving or depending on several variables.

words.tr: n. 微积分学；（人体内的）结石
words.ex: He is learning calculus at school.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学校学习微积分。
words.en: Calculus is a branch of mathematics that deals with the finding and properties of derivatives and integrals of functions, by methods originally based on the summation of infinitesimal differences.

words.tr: phrase. 微分方程（含有未知函数及其导数的方程）
words.ex: He solves a differential equation every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天解一个微分方程。
words.en: An equation involving derivatives of a function or functions.

words.w: not know the first thing about
words.tr: phrase. 对…一窍不通；对…一无所知
words.uk: nɒt nəʊ ðə fɜːst θɪŋ əˈbaʊt
words.us: nɑːt noʊ ðə fɜːrst θɪŋ əˈbaʊt
words.ex: He does not know the first thing about cooking.
words.ex_cn: 他根本不懂烹饪。
words.en: If you say that you do not know the first thing about something, you are emphasizing that you know absolutely nothing about it.

words.w: not understand the first thing about
words.tr: phrase. 对…一窍不通；对…完全不懂
words.uk: nɒt ˌʌndəˈstænd ðə fɜːst θɪŋ əˈbaʊt
words.us: nɑːt ˌʌndərˈstænd ðə fɜːrst θɪŋ əˈbaʊt
words.ex: He does not understand the first thing about cooking.
words.ex_cn: 他根本不懂烹饪。
words.en: To have no knowledge or understanding whatsoever about a particular subject or topic.

words.ex: The two colors distinguish the two teams.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色使两个队伍有所不同。
words.en: If you can distinguish one thing from another, you can see or understand how they are different.

words.ex: The signal transmission is clear and strong.
words.ex_cn: 信号传输清晰而强劲。
words.en: The act or process of sending or passing something from one place, person, or thing to another.

words.ex: The car's alternator is not working.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的交流发电机坏了。
words.en: An alternator is a device that converts mechanical energy into electrical energy in the form of alternating current.

words.ex: The mechanic fixed my car quickly.
words.ex_cn: 机修工很快修好了我的车。
words.en: A mechanic is a person whose job is to repair and maintain machines and engines, especially those of vehicles.

words.ex: He used the opener to open the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 他用开瓶器打开了瓶子。
words.en: An opener is a device or tool used to open something, such as a bottle or can, or the first event in a series of events.

words.tr: phrase. 因无知而犯错；不知道有更好的做法；不懂事
words.ex: He was rude because he did not know any better.
words.ex_cn: 他之所以粗鲁，是因为他不懂得更好。
words.en: To not have the knowledge or experience to behave or think in a more appropriate or acceptable way.

words.ex: He craves chocolate when he is stressed.
words.ex_cn: 当他感到压力时，他渴望吃巧克力。
words.en: If you crave something, or crave for it, you want to have it very much.

words.ex: He wore a decent shirt to the interview.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件像样的衬衫去面试。
words.en: Decent is used to describe something which is considered to be of an acceptable standard or quality.

words.tr: 短语动词，情不自禁做某事；忍不住做某事
words.ex: I can't help laughing when I see that funny cat.
words.ex_cn: 当我看到那只搞笑的猫时，忍不住笑了。
words.en: If you say that you can't help doing something, you mean that you can't prevent yourself from doing it.

words.ex: A shudder ran through her when she saw the snake.
words.ex_cn: 当她看到蛇时，全身战栗了一下。
words.en: If you shudder, you shake with fear, horror, or disgust, or because you are cold.

words.tr: 处于不利地位；处于劣势
words.ex: He is at a disadvantage because he doesn't speak English well.
words.ex_cn: 他因为英语说不好而处于劣势。
words.en: If you are at a disadvantage, you are in a situation in which you are less likely to succeed than others because of something that makes it harder for you to compete.

words.ex: When it comes to math, he always feels nervous.
words.ex_cn: 说到数学，他总是感到紧张。
words.en: You use 'when it comes to' to introduce a subject or activity that you are about to discuss or deal with.

words.ex: His silence implies he disagrees.
words.ex_cn: 他的沉默暗示他不同意。
words.en: To suggest or indicate something indirectly rather than stating it explicitly.

words.ex: The boy has an abnormal heartbeat.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩的心跳不正常。
words.en: Deviating from what is normal or usual, typically in a way that is undesirable or worrying.

words.ex: He had a stumble on the rocky path.
words.ex_cn: 他在布满石头的小路上绊了一跤。
words.en: To stumble means to trip or momentarily lose one's balance while walking or running. It can also refer to speaking in a hesitant or faltering manner.

words.tr: phrase. 偶然发现；意外闯入；无意中陷入（某种情况或地方）
words.ex: He stumbled into the room with a big smile.
words.ex_cn: 他笑着跌跌撞撞地走进了房间。
words.en: To enter a place or situation by chance or without intending to.

words.ex: The children played in the grit near the road.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在路边的沙砾中玩耍。
words.en: Grit is very small pieces of stone. It is often used to make surfaces less slippery. Grit is also a quality of character that enables someone to continue with determination in the face of difficulties.

words.tr: phrase. v. 咬紧牙关（表示决心、忍耐或愤怒）
words.ex: He grits his teeth when the pain starts.
words.ex_cn: 当疼痛开始时，他咬紧牙关。
words.en: To clench one's teeth together, especially in order to keep one's resolve when faced with an unpleasant or difficult situation.

words.ex: He solves algebra problems every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天解代数题。
words.en: Algebra is a branch of mathematics in which letters and symbols are used to represent numbers and quantities in formulae and equations.

words.ex: The dark clouds are an indication of rain.
words.ex_cn: 乌云是下雨的迹象。
words.en: An indication is a sign which suggests, for example, what people are thinking or feeling.

words.tr:
v. 重取；重新摄制；重考
n. 重取；重新摄制；重考
words.ex: He will retake the math test next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将重考数学考试。
words.en: To take something again, especially a photograph or a film scene, or to take control of a place again after losing it.

words.tr:
n. 恐慌；
v. 感到恐慌；
words.ex: A panic spread through the crowd when the fire alarm rang.
words.ex_cn: 当火警响起时，人群陷入了恐慌。
words.en: Panic is a very strong feeling of anxiety or fear, which makes you act without thinking carefully.

words.ex: The bees made a loud buzz near the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂在花附近发出嗡嗡声。
words.en: To make a low, continuous, humming or sibilant sound, like that made by bees or flies.

words.ex: The fluorescent lamp lights up the room quickly.
words.ex_cn: 荧光灯很快照亮了房间。
words.en: Fluorescent substances produce bright light of a particular color when they are exposed to light of a different wavelength.

words.ex: The classroom uses a fluorescent light.
words.ex_cn: 教室用的是荧光灯。
words.en: A fluorescent light is a type of light that uses a fluorescent tube to produce light, which is more energy-efficient than traditional incandescent bulbs.

words.ex: Estrogen helps women's bodies grow and change.
words.ex_cn: 雌激素帮助女性身体发育和变化。
words.en: A hormone that is important for the development and regulation of the female reproductive system and secondary sex characteristics.

words.ex: He is learning thermodynamics in physics class.
words.ex_cn: 他正在物理课上学习热力学。
words.en: Thermodynamics is the branch of physical science that deals with the relations between heat and other forms of energy (such as mechanical, electrical, or chemical energy), and, by extension, of the relationships between all forms of energy.

words.tr: n. 女性特质；女性气质
words.ex: She shows her femininity through gentle words and kind actions.
words.ex_cn: 她通过温柔的话语和善良的举动展现女性气质。
words.en: Femininity refers to the qualities or attributes regarded as characteristic of women or girls.

words.tr: adj. 有缺陷的；有故障的；有错误的；
words.ex: The faulty phone keeps turning off.
words.ex_cn: 这部有缺陷的手机总是自动关机。
words.en: If you describe something as faulty, you mean that it is not perfect or it has some weaknesses.

words.ex: The premise of his argument is that everyone is equal.
words.ex_cn: 他论点的前提是人人平等。
words.en: A premise is a statement or idea that forms the basis for a reasonable line of argument.

words.ex: They learned about cultural traditions during the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在旅行中了解了文化传统。
words.en: Relating to the ideas, customs, and social behavior of a society.

words.tr:
n. 婴儿；
adj. 初期的；
words.ex: The infant is sleeping in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在婴儿床里睡觉。
words.en: An infant is a baby or very young child.

words.tr: n. 电视游戏；可视游戏
words.ex: He plays videogame every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上玩电子游戏。
words.en: A videogame is an electronic game that involves interaction with a user interface to generate visual feedback on a video device such as a TV screen or computer monitor.

words.ex: The movie was incredibly funny.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极其搞笑。
words.en: In a manner that is difficult to believe; extremely.

words.ex: The movie was incredible.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影太棒了。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as incredible, you like them very much or are impressed by them, because they are extremely or unusually good.

words.ex: She is flexible with her schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她的日程安排很灵活。
words.en: Able to change or be changed easily according to the situation.

words.tr:
n. 跳跃；
v. 跳跃；
words.ex: The cat made a big leap over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 猫跳过了篱笆。
words.en: To leap means to jump high or a long way, or to move quickly and with a lot of energy.

words.tr: phrase. 一种基于信念而非确凿证据的冒险行为；信靠的飞跃
words.ex: He took a leap of faith and quit his job to start a business.
words.ex_cn: 他鼓起勇气辞掉了工作，开始创业。
words.en: An act of believing in or attempting something whose existence or outcome cannot be proved or known.

words.tr: adj. 选择性的；精挑细选的；
words.ex: He is selective about what he eats.
words.ex_cn: 他对吃的东西很挑剔。
words.en: If you are selective, you choose things carefully, for example, the things that you buy or do.

words.ex: He started his project anew after the failure.
words.ex_cn: 失败后，他重新开始了他的项目。
words.en: If you do something anew, you do it again, often in a different way from before.

words.ex: He lives for playing football every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都靠踢足球而活着。
words.en: If you say that someone lives for something, you mean that it is the most important thing in their life.

words.tr: phrase. 因某事而邀功；把某事的功劳归于自己
words.ex: He takes credit for winning the game.
words.ex_cn: 他把赢得比赛的功劳归于自己。
words.en: To claim or accept praise or recognition for something, often when it is not entirely deserved.

words.tr: 短语动词. 因某事获得认可或赞誉；因某事得到学分或功劳
words.ex: He got credit for helping his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他因为帮助朋友而得到了认可。
words.en: To receive recognition or praise for something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 因某事获得认可或赞誉；因某事得到学分或信任
words.ex: He gained credit for helping his friend with homework.
words.ex_cn: 他因为帮助朋友做作业而获得了学分。
words.en: To receive recognition or praise for something.

words.tr: n. 一回；一次；发作；拳击比赛
words.ex: He had a bout of coughing last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚咳了一阵子。
words.en: A bout of something is a short period of time during which it occurs a lot or is especially severe.

words.ex: We had a small party last Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 我们上个星期六举办了一个小型聚会。
words.en: A party is a social gathering of invited guests, typically involving eating, drinking, and entertainment.

words.tr: 短语. 近在咫尺；几乎就要发生或实现
words.ex: The mountain is a breath away from the village.
words.ex_cn: 这座山离村庄只有咫尺之遥。
words.en: Extremely close to something, often in a figurative sense of being near to achieving or experiencing something.

words.ex: He is an undergraduate at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的一名本科生。
words.en: An undergraduate is a student at a university or college who is studying for their first degree.

words.ex: The journalist wrote a story about the earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 记者写了一篇关于地震的文章。
words.en: A journalist is a person whose job is to collect news and write about it for newspapers, magazines, television, or radio.

words.tr: n. 勋爵；主；上帝；统治者；
words.ex: The lord lived in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 这位勋爵住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A lord is a man who has a high rank in the nobility, especially in Britain, or a man who has authority or control over others.

words.ex: The country is facing an economic crisis.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正面临经济危机。
words.en: A crisis is a situation in which something or someone is affected by one or more very serious problems.

words.tr: v. 恳求；辩护；答辩；以…为理由
words.ex: He pleaded for help when he was lost.
words.ex_cn: 当他迷路时，他恳求帮助。
words.en: If you plead with someone to do something, you ask them in an intense, emotional way to do it.

words.ex: He will renew his passport next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会更新他的护照。
words.en: To renew something means to begin it again or to make it new again.

words.ex: He has a positive attitude toward life.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活持积极的态度。
words.en: If you are positive about things, you are hopeful and confident, and think of the good aspects of a situation rather than the bad ones.

words.ex: The bridge is made of steel.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥是用钢建造的。
words.en: Steel is a very strong metal made mainly from iron. It is used for making many things such as bridges, buildings, and vehicles.

words.tr: adj. 支持的；支援的；给予帮助的；
words.ex: My parents are supportive when I study hard.
words.ex_cn: 当我努力学习时，我的父母总是支持我。
words.en: If you are supportive, you are kind and helpful to someone at a difficult or unhappy time in their life.

words.ex: The sponge soaks up water quickly.
words.ex_cn: 海绵很快吸水。
words.en: To absorb or take in (a liquid, knowledge, or experience) fully.

words.tr: phrase. 每当有机会时；一有机会就
words.ex: He practices English at every opportunity.
words.ex_cn: 他抓住每一个机会练习英语。
words.en: Whenever possible or whenever there is a chance.

words.tr: phrase. 压低；使沉重；使疲惫不堪
words.ex: The heavy bag will weigh you down.
words.ex_cn: 这个重袋子会让你行动不便。
words.en: To cause someone to feel worried or burdened.

words.tr: n. 局外人；无取胜希望者；
words.ex: He felt like an outsider at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在聚会上感觉像个局外人。
words.en: An outsider is someone who does not belong to a particular group or organization.

words.ex: He starts his new class in the fall semester.
words.ex_cn: 他在秋季学期开始他的新课程。
words.en: A semester is one of the two periods that the school or college year is divided into, especially in the United States and Canada.

words.ex: The expense of the trip was higher than expected.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的费用比预期的要高。
words.en: An expense is the amount of money that you spend on something.

words.ex: Please stir the soup before serving.
words.ex_cn: 请在上菜前搅拌一下汤。
words.en: To mix a substance or move it around using a spoon or other object; to cause to move or act; to arouse or excite.

words.ex: There are plentiful apples in the basket.
words.ex_cn: 篮子里有丰富的苹果。
words.en: If something is plentiful, there is a lot of it available.

words.tr:
n. 快照；
v. 突然断裂；猛然咬；
adj. 突然的；匆忙的；
words.ex: He took a snap of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他拍了一张日落的快照。
words.en: If something snaps or if you snap it, it breaks suddenly, usually with a sharp cracking noise. | A snap is a photograph. | If someone snaps, or if something snaps inside them, they suddenly stop being calm and become very angry.

words.ex: He had a realization that he needed to change his life.
words.ex_cn: 他领悟到自己需要改变生活。
words.en: The act of becoming fully aware of something as a fact; the achievement of something desired or anticipated.

words.tr: phrase. 处于控制之中；掌握局势；能控制局面
words.ex: He is in control of the car.
words.ex_cn: 他掌控着这辆车。
words.en: Having the power to influence or direct people's behavior or the course of events.

words.tr: phrase. 掌管某事；控制某事物；对某事有支配权
words.ex: He is in control of the project.
words.ex_cn: 他负责这个项目。
words.en: Having the power to influence or direct people's behavior or the course of events.

words.tr: adj. 有微风的；轻松愉快的
words.ex: The park was breezy and full of people enjoying the weather.
words.ex_cn: 公园里微风习习，到处都是享受天气的人们。
words.en: If you describe something as breezy, you mean that it is light, informal, and cheerful.

words.ex: He seeks after truth in every book he reads.
words.ex_cn: 他每读一本书都在追求真理。
words.en: To try to find or obtain something, often something that is difficult to get.

words.ex: The messiness of his room makes it hard to walk.
words.ex_cn: 他房间的杂乱让走路都很难。
words.en: The state of being untidy or disorganized.

words.ex: His room is messy with clothes everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 他的房间很杂乱，衣服到处都是。
words.en: If you describe something as messy, you mean that it is untidy or dirty.

words.tr: adj. 大规模的；大而重的；
words.ex: The company launched a massive advertising campaign.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司发起了一场大规模的广告活动。
words.en: Something that is massive is extremely large in size, amount, or extent.

words.ex: I ate an apple as a snack after school.
words.ex_cn: 我放学后吃了一个苹果当小吃。
words.en: A snack is a small amount of food that is eaten between meals.

words.tr:
n. 游行；阅兵；
v. 游行；阅兵；
words.ex: The city held a big parade on Independence Day.
words.ex_cn: 城市在独立日举行了盛大的游行。
words.en: A parade is a procession of people or vehicles moving through a public place in order to celebrate an important day or event.

words.tr: phrase. 流行歌曲排行榜；热门歌曲榜单
words.ex: The song topped the hit parade for several weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在流行榜上蝉联了数周的冠军。
words.en: A list or ranking of the most popular songs at a given time.

words.tr:
v. 使腐败；
adj. 腐败的；
words.ex: The official was corrupt by taking bribes.
words.ex_cn: 这位官员因收受贿赂而腐败。
words.en: If someone is corrupt, they do things that are dishonest or illegal in order to gain money or power.

words.tr:
v. 禁止；
n. 禁止；
words.ex: The school bans phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If there is a ban on something, it is not allowed. If something is banned, it is not allowed to be done, shown, or used.

words.ex: He listens to music with his old walkman.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的旧随身听听音乐。
words.en: A Walkman is a small portable cassette player, radio, or CD player with headphones, used especially for listening to music while on the move.

words.ex: The movie is fascinating because it shows strange aliens.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极有吸引力，因为它展示了奇怪的外星人。
words.en: If you describe something as fascinating, you find it very interesting and attractive, and your thoughts tend to concentrate on it.

words.tr: phrase. 严格地说；确切地讲
words.ex: Strictly speaking, this answer is wrong.
words.ex_cn: 严格来说，这个答案是错的。
words.en: If you say that something is true strictly speaking, you mean that it is true if you consider it in its most limited or exact sense.

words.ex: He invented a new machine to clean the house.
words.ex_cn: 他发明了一台新机器来打扫房子。
words.en: To invent something means to design or create it, especially something that has never been made before.

words.ex: The telephone was a great invention.
words.ex_cn: 电话是一项伟大的发明。
words.en: An invention is a unique or novel device, method, composition or process. It may be an improvement upon a machine or product, or a new process for creating an object or a result. An invention that achieves a completely unique function or result may be a radical breakthrough. Such works are novel and not obvious to others skilled in the same field.

words.ex: The manufacturer makes cars in this factory.
words.ex_cn: 这家制造商在这家工厂生产汽车。
words.en: A manufacturer is a person or company that produces goods in large quantities, especially in a factory.

words.ex: His tolerance for different opinions is impressive.
words.ex_cn: 他对不同观点的宽容令人印象深刻。
words.en: The ability or willingness to tolerate the existence of opinions or behaviour that one dislikes or disagrees with.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种程度上；到……程度（用于表达程度的限定，中间可插入形容词，如 to a large extent）
words.ex: He is right to a small extent, but not completely.
words.ex_cn: 他在一定程度上是对的，但不完全对。
words.en: Used to indicate the degree to which something is the case.

words.ex: Water is a basic necessity for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本必需品。
words.en: Something that is necessary or indispensable.

words.tr:
n. 盎格鲁-撒克逊人；盎格鲁-撒克逊语
adj. 盎格鲁-撒克逊人的；盎格鲁-撒克逊语的
words.ex: The anglo-saxon people lived in England long ago.
words.ex_cn: 盎格鲁-撒克逊人很久以前生活在英格兰。
words.en: Relating to the Germanic inhabitants of England from the 5th century AD to the Norman Conquest.

words.tr:
n. 核；核心；重点；
adj. 核心的；
words.ex: The core of the apple is not edible.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的核心不能吃。
words.en: The central or most important part of something.

words.ex: The movie aroused his curiosity.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影激起了他的好奇心。
words.en: If something arouses a particular reaction or attitude in people, it causes them to have that reaction or attitude.

words.tr:
n. 海峡；渠道；河床；频道；
v. 引导；
words.ex: The English Channel separates England from France.
words.ex_cn: 英吉利海峡将英格兰与法国分隔开。
words.en: A channel is a television station and the programs that it broadcasts. A channel is also a method or system that people use to send information, goods, etc. to each other.

words.ex: He will surrender when he sees the police.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到警察时，他会投降。
words.en: If you surrender, you stop fighting or resisting someone and agree that you have been beaten.

words.tr: 为了产生某种效果；为了给人印象
words.ex: He spoke slowly for effect.
words.ex_cn: 他说话很慢，为了产生效果。
words.en: In order to create a particular impression or to be deliberately dramatic.

words.ex: The army tried to invade the neighboring country.
words.ex_cn: 军队试图侵犯邻国。
words.en: To enter a country, town, or region by force in order to take control of it.

words.tr: abbr. 公元前；“before Christ”的缩写
words.ex: The pyramid was built in 2500 b.c.
words.ex_cn: 这座金字塔建于公元前2500年。
words.en: Before Christ; used to indicate that a date is before the Christian era.

words.tr: n. （考古）斧，锛头（带斜刃的史前石头或金属器具）；凯尔特人（Celt）
words.ex: He wears a celtic necklace to honor his heritage.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着凯尔特项链以纪念他的传统。
words.en: The Celts were an Indo-European people in Iron Age and Medieval Europe who spoke Celtic languages and had cultural similarities.

words.ex: Birds inhabit the forest near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类居住在湖边的森林里。
words.en: If a place or region is inhabited by a group of people or a species of animal, those people or animals live there.

words.ex: He enjoys eating Welsh rarebit on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末吃威尔士兔肉。
words.en: To fail to honor a debt or obligation, especially a gambling debt.

words.tr: n. 谜；难以理解的事物；
words.ex: The mystery of the missing key puzzled everyone.
words.ex_cn: 丢失的钥匙这个谜题让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: Something that is difficult or impossible to understand or explain.

words.ex: The theory of gravity explains why things fall down.
words.ex_cn: 重力理论解释了为什么东西会往下掉。
words.en: A theory is a formal idea or set of ideas that is intended to explain something.

words.ex: He is learning Sanskrit from an old teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他正在向一位老教师学习梵语。
words.en: Sanskrit is an ancient Indo-Aryan language that is the classical language of India and of Hinduism.

words.ex: The boy resembles his father.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩长得像他父亲。
words.en: If one thing or person resembles another, they are similar to each other.

words.ex: There is a resemblance between the two brothers.
words.ex_cn: 这两兄弟之间有相似之处。
words.en: If there is a resemblance between two people or things, they are similar to each other.

words.tr:
adj. 拉丁语的；拉丁语系国家的；
n. 拉丁语；
words.ex: He read a latin text in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上读了一篇拉丁语文本。
words.en: Latin is the language of ancient Rome and its empire, widely used historically as a language of scholarship and administration.

words.ex: He follows a systematic approach to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种系统的方法来解决数学问题。
words.en: A systematic approach or method is one that is done according to a fixed plan, in a thorough and efficient way.

words.ex: The sun descends behind the hills.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在山后落下。
words.en: If you descend or if you descend a staircase, you move downwards from a higher to a lower level.

words.tr: n. 通晓数国语言的人；语言学家；
words.ex: He is a linguist who speaks five languages.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位通晓五种语言的人。
words.en: A linguist is someone who studies language or languages, especially a person who studies linguistics.

words.ex: He ran fast to come up with the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: If you come up with a plan, idea, or solution, you think of it and suggest it.

words.tr: adj. 印欧语系的；印欧语系人种的
words.ex: The Indo-European languages include English and Spanish.
words.ex_cn: 印欧语系包括英语和西班牙语。
words.en: Relating to the family of languages spoken over the greater part of Europe and Asia as far as northern India.

words.ex: The wolf howled at the moon.
words.ex_cn: 狼对着月亮嚎叫。
words.en: A wolf is a wild animal that is related to the dog and lives and hunts in groups.

words.ex: The scholar published a book about ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这位学者出版了一本关于古代历史的书。
words.en: A scholar is a person who studies an academic subject and knows a lot about it.

words.ex: They established a new school in the village.
words.ex_cn: 他们在村里建立了一所新学校。
words.en: To set up or create something, such as an organization or a system, on a firm or permanent basis.

words.tr:
n. 流动；
v. 漂移；
words.ex: The drift of the river carries leaves downstream.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流动将树叶冲向下游。
words.en: If something or someone drifts somewhere, they move there slowly or gradually. As a noun, drift can refer to a slow, gradual movement or change, or the general meaning or intent of something.

words.ex: The climate in summer is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 夏天的气候非常炎热。
words.en: The climate of a place is the general weather conditions that are typical of it.

words.ex: The settlers moved westward to find new land.
words.ex_cn: 定居者向西迁移以寻找新土地。
words.en: Toward the west.

words.tr: adj. 日耳曼语的；德语的；日耳曼人的；
words.ex: The Germanic languages include English and German.
words.ex_cn: 日耳曼语包括英语和德语。
words.en: Relating to the Germanic peoples or their languages.

words.ex: The tribe lives in the forest and follows old traditions.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在森林里，遵循古老的传统。
words.en: A tribe is a social division in a traditional society consisting of families or communities linked by social, economic, religious, or blood ties, with a common culture and dialect, typically having a recognized leader.

words.tr: phrase. 把某物转交给某人；把某事传达给某人；将某物传给某人
words.ex: He passed the book on to his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他把书传给了他的弟弟。
words.en: To give something to someone else, especially after receiving it from another person.

words.tr:
n. 影响（力）；
v. 影响；
words.ex: The teacher had a big influence on her students.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生们有很大的影响。
words.en: The power to affect, control, or manipulate someone or something.

words.ex: He believes in Christianity and goes to church every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他信仰基督教，每周日都去教堂。
words.en: Christianity is a monotheistic religion based on the life and teachings of Jesus Christ as presented in the New Testament.

words.tr:
n. 基督教徒；
adj. 基督教的；
words.ex: He is a christian who goes to church every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名每周日都去教堂的基督教徒。
words.en: A Christian is a person who believes in Jesus Christ and follows his teachings.

words.ex: The new job enriched his life.
words.ex_cn: 这份新工作使他的生活富裕起来。
words.en: To enrich something means to improve its quality, often by adding something to it.

words.ex: He was a faithful disciple of the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他是老师的一名忠实弟子。
words.en: A disciple is a follower or student of a teacher, leader, or philosopher.

words.tr:
n. 殉道者；殉教者；烈士
v. 处死；折磨
words.ex: He became a martyr for freedom.
words.ex_cn: 他为自由而成为烈士。
words.en: A martyr is someone who is killed or made to suffer greatly because of their religious or political beliefs, and is admired and respected by people who share those beliefs.

words.tr: adj. 挪威的；挪威人的；斯堪的纳维亚语的; n. 挪威人；挪威语
words.ex: He likes to read Norse myths about gods and giants.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读关于神和巨人的北欧神话。
words.en: Relating to Norway, its people, or its language.

words.ex: The addition of a new chair made the room more comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 增加一把新椅子让房间更舒适了。
words.en: An addition is something that is added to something else, often to improve it or make it larger.

words.tr:
adj. 诺曼人的；
n. 诺曼底人；
words.ex: The Norman soldiers wore heavy armor.
words.ex_cn: 诺曼士兵穿着厚重的盔甲。
words.en: A Norman is a member of the people of Normandy in northern France, especially in the context of the Norman conquest of England in 1066.

words.ex: The army conquered the small city after a long battle.
words.ex_cn: 军队经过长期战斗征服了这座小城。
words.en: To conquer means to take control of a country or city and its people by force, or to successfully deal with or control something.

words.tr: adj. 国王的；高贵的，国王似的
words.ex: He wore a kingly crown at the ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 他在仪式上戴了一顶王者的王冠。
words.en: Having the qualities or status of a king; regal.

words.ex: The royal family lives in a big palace.
words.ex_cn: 皇室住在一座大宫殿里。
words.en: Royal is used to describe something that is connected with a king, queen, or emperor, or with their family. It can also describe something that is splendid or magnificent, befitting a king or queen.

words.tr:
n. 最高统治者；君主；元首
adj. 独立自主的；拥有最高统治权的
words.ex: The sovereign makes important decisions for the country.
words.ex_cn: 君主为国家做出重要决定。
words.en: A sovereign is a king, queen, or other supreme ruler.

words.tr: n. 替代选择；替代选择（alternative 的复数）；
words.ex: We need to find better alternatives to plastic.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要找到比塑料更好的替代选择。
words.en: An alternative is something that you can choose to do or use instead of something else.

words.ex: He will modify the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会更改计划。
words.en: To change something slightly, especially in order to make it more suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The renaissance brought new art and ideas to Europe.
words.ex_cn: 文艺复兴为欧洲带来了新的艺术和思想。
words.en: The Renaissance was a period in European history marking the transition from the Middle Ages to modernity and covering the 15th and 16th centuries, characterized by an effort to revive and surpass ideas and achievements of classical antiquity.

words.tr:
adj. 古罗马的；罗马人的；
n. 古罗马人；
words.ex: The ancient roman roads are still visible today.
words.ex_cn: 古老的罗马道路至今仍清晰可见。
words.en: A Roman is a person who comes from Rome or is connected with Rome. It can also refer to the style of printing or writing that uses upright letters, as opposed to italic.

words.ex: He took a capsule for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一粒胶囊来缓解头痛。
words.en: A capsule is a small container or case, especially one that is sealed and contains a dose of medicine, or a spacecraft's compartment for astronauts.

words.tr: adj. 惯常的；习惯性的；经常的；
words.ex: He is a habitual smoker.
words.ex_cn: 他是个惯常的吸烟者。
words.en: A habitual action, state, or way of behaving is one that someone usually does or has, especially one that is considered to be typical or characteristic of them.

words.ex: The earthquake was a catastrophe.
words.ex_cn: 这场地震是一场灾难。
words.en: An event causing great and often sudden damage or suffering; a disaster.

words.ex: He checked the thermometer to see the temperature.
words.ex_cn: 他看了温度计来查看温度。
words.en: A thermometer is an instrument for measuring and indicating temperature.

words.ex: He spends hours in cyberspace every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天在虚拟空间里花几个小时。
words.en: Cyberspace is the notional environment in which communication over computer networks occurs.

words.ex: The settler built a house near the river.
words.ex_cn: 这位定居者在河边建了一所房子。
words.en: A settler is a person who moves to a new place with the intention of staying there, especially in a previously uninhabited or sparsely inhabited area.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；
words.ex: The river's source is in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的源头在山里。
words.en: The place, person, or thing from which something comes or can be obtained.

words.tr: phrase. 失控的；无法控制的；失去控制的
words.ex: The car was out of control on the icy road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在结冰的路面上失去了控制。
words.en: If something is out of control, no one has any power over it.

words.ex: He goes to a music academy every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末去音乐学院。
words.en: An academy is a type of school for special training or a society for the advancement of art, science, or literature.

words.tr: phrase. 实施；付诸实践；把…应用到实践中
words.ex: He learned to put his new skills into practice at work.
words.ex_cn: 他学会了在工作中把新技能付诸实践。
words.en: To apply or implement something in a real situation.

words.tr:
adj. 丹麦的；丹麦人的；丹麦语的；
n. 丹麦语；
words.ex: He ate a Danish pastry for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一块丹麦糕点。
words.en: Of or relating to Denmark, its people, or their language.

words.tr: n. 尊敬的人；势利的人
words.ex: He is a respecter of old traditions.
words.ex_cn: 他是旧传统的尊重者。
words.en: A respecter is someone who shows respect or consideration towards others.

words.ex: The address is 720 liberty street.
words.ex_cn: 地址是自由大街720号。
words.en: The state of being free within society from oppressive restrictions imposed by authority on one's way of life, behavior, or political views.

words.tr: phrase. （在棒球中）三振出局；（比喻）失败或未能成功；划掉（文字）
words.ex: He strike out three times in the baseball game.
words.ex_cn: 他在棒球比赛中三振出局三次。
words.en: To remove something by drawing a line through it; to start doing something new or different; to fail or be unsuccessful in an attempt.

words.ex: Mother's milk nourishes the baby.
words.ex_cn: 母乳滋养婴儿。
words.en: To nourish someone or something means to provide them with the food and other substances they need in order to live, grow, and be healthy.

words.ex: The soldier shoot at the target.
words.ex_cn: 士兵向目标射击。
words.en: To shoot means to fire a bullet from a gun or to take a photograph. It can also refer to the act of a plant sprouting or a player attempting to score in sports by sending the ball or puck towards the goal.

words.tr: phrase. 跳起来；发生；迅速发展
words.ex: The ball springs up when it hits the ground.
words.ex_cn: 球碰到地面时跳起来。
words.en: To appear or develop quickly and/or suddenly.

words.tr:
v. 保存；保护；保持；
n. （某群体）专有的活动；
words.ex: She preserves fresh fruit by making jam.
words.ex_cn: 她通过做果酱来保存新鲜水果。
words.en: To preserve something means to maintain it in its original or existing state.

words.tr: n. 语法专家；文法家；语言学专家；
words.ex: The grammarian corrected the student's sentence.
words.ex_cn: 语法专家纠正了学生的句子。
words.en: A grammarian is a person who studies and writes about grammar.

words.ex: The elite of the city often meet at private clubs.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的精英经常在私人俱乐部会面。
words.en: You can refer to the most powerful, rich, or talented people within a particular group, place, or society as the elite.

words.ex: Her talent is unparalleled.
words.ex_cn: 她的才华是无比的。
words.en: Having no parallel or equal; unmatched.

words.ex: The new app has high penetration in young markets.
words.ex_cn: 这款新应用在年轻市场中普及率很高。
words.en: The act or process of making a way into or through something; the ability to understand or find something out.

words.tr:
n. 一系列；（变化）范围；山脉；
v. （在某范围内）变化；包括（各种不同的人或物）；
words.ex: The store offers a range of colors.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供一系列颜色。
words.en: A range of things is a number of different things of the same general kind.

words.ex: He uses an electronic book to read.
words.ex_cn: 他用电子书来阅读。
words.en: Electronic means relating to devices or systems that operate by controlling the flow of electrons, especially in a vacuum, gas, or semiconductor.

words.ex: The retrieval of lost files took a long time.
words.ex_cn: 找回丢失文件花费了很长时间。
words.en: The act of getting something back from somewhere.

words.ex: The car exceeded the speed limit.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车超过了限速。
words.en: To be greater in quantity, degree, or intensity than something else.

words.ex: The sentence has a grammatical error.
words.ex_cn: 这个句子有一个语法错误。
words.en: Relating to grammar or the rules of grammar.

words.ex: He majors in economics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修经济学。
words.en: Economics is the study of the way in which money, industry, and trade are organized in a society.

words.ex: Good management helps a company grow.
words.ex_cn: 良好的管理有助于公司发展。
words.en: The control and organization of something, especially a business and its employees.

words.ex: Watching movies is a popular entertainment.
words.ex_cn: 看电影是一种流行的休闲娱乐。
words.en: Entertainment refers to performances or activities that are intended to amuse or interest an audience.

words.ex: He lived in a crude hut with no electricity.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个没有电的简陋小屋里。
words.en: A crude substance or product is in its natural state and has not been processed or refined.

words.ex: He is a physicist who studies stars.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位研究恒星的物理学家。
words.en: A physicist is a scientist who specializes in the field of physics, which is the study of matter, energy, and the fundamental forces of nature.

words.tr:
v. 实施；传导（电、热）；
n. 行为；举止；
words.ex: The company will conduct a survey next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司将在下周进行一项调查。
words.en: To organize and carry out a particular activity.

words.tr: v. 贡献；促成；捐献；投稿；
words.ex: He contributes money to the charity.
words.ex_cn: 他向慈善机构捐款。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.ex: Small commerce helps local towns grow.
words.ex_cn: 小商业有助于小镇的发展。
words.en: Commerce is the activity of buying and selling things, especially on a large scale.

words.ex: He tried to integrate into the new school community.
words.ex_cn: 他试图融入新的学校群体。
words.en: If someone integrates into a social group, or is integrated into it, they behave in such a way that they become part of the group or are accepted into it.

words.ex: He speaks a local dialect in his village.
words.ex_cn: 他在村子里说一种地方方言。
words.en: A dialect is a form of a language that is spoken in a particular area and that uses some of its own words, grammar, and pronunciations.

words.ex: His dominance in the game surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的支配表现让所有人感到惊讶。
words.en: Dominance is the state of being more powerful, important, or noticeable than other people or things.

words.tr:
adj. 总的；全面的；总体的；
adv. 总计；大致上；
words.ex: The overall cost is too high.
words.ex_cn: 总成本太高了。
words.en: You use overall to indicate that you are talking about a situation in general or about the whole of something.

words.ex: He compresses the file to save space.
words.ex_cn: 他压缩文件以节省空间。
words.en: To compress something means to press it or squeeze it so that it takes up less space.

words.ex: The new teacher transformed the class into a lively group.
words.ex_cn: 这位新老师把班级变成了一个充满活力的团体。
words.en: To transform something or someone means to change them completely and usually improve their appearance, form, or structure.

words.ex: The old rules give way to new ones.
words.ex_cn: 旧规则让位于新规则。
words.en: If something gives way to something else, it is replaced by it.

words.ex: The school values diversity in its students.
words.ex_cn: 学校重视学生的多样性。
words.en: The state of being diverse; variety.

words.tr:
n. 特点；特性；
adj. 典型的；特有的；
words.ex: Honesty is a key characteristic of a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一个好朋友的关键特点。
words.en: A characteristic is a quality or feature that is typical of someone or something.

words.ex: This painting is unique because no other like it exists.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是独特的，因为没有其他类似的。
words.en: Something that is unique is the only one of its kind.

words.tr: n. 权威；官方机构；权力；权威人士；当局；
words.ex: The teacher is an authority on ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师是古代史方面的权威。
words.en: The power to make decisions or enforce rules.

words.tr: 短语. 仅举几例；列举几个（用于引出部分例子）
words.ex: I like fruits, such as apples, bananas, and oranges, to name a few.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，比如苹果、香蕉和橙子，等等。
words.en: Used when mentioning a small number of examples from a larger group.

words.ex: The team showed unity in winning the match.
words.ex_cn: 团队在赢得比赛时展现了统一。
words.en: Unity refers to the state of being united or joined as a whole.

words.ex: One aspect of learning English is practicing speaking.
words.ex_cn: 学习英语的一个方面是练习口语。
words.en: An aspect of something is one of the parts of its character or nature.

words.ex: The old woman predict rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 那位老妇人预言明天会下雨。
words.en: If you predict an event, you say that it will happen.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 在过渡中；处于转变阶段
words.ex: The city is in transition from old buildings to new ones.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市正在从旧建筑向新建筑转型。
words.en: In a state of change from one condition or form to another.

words.tr: phrase. 使自己摆脱；解除；清除
words.ex: He wants to rid himself of bad habits.
words.ex_cn: 他想改掉坏习惯。
words.en: To free oneself from something unwanted or unpleasant.

words.ex: He joined a local book association.
words.ex_cn: 他加入了一个本地的图书协会。
words.en: An association is an official group of people who have the same job, aim, or interest.

words.ex: Whoever wants to join can sign up.
words.ex_cn: 任何想加入的人都可以报名。
words.en: used to refer to any person or people, when it does not matter who

words.tr: adj. 两种语言的；用两种语言的；
words.ex: He is a bilingual student who speaks English and Spanish.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个会说英语和西班牙语的双语学生。
words.en: A bilingual person is someone who can speak two languages equally well.

words.ex: This region has many mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有很多山。
words.en: A region is a large area of land that is different from other areas of land, for example because it is one of the different parts of a country with its own customs and characteristics, or because it has a particular geographical feature.

words.tr: adj. 大量的；重大的；实质性的；
words.ex: He made a substantial profit from the sale.
words.ex_cn: 他从这次销售中获得了大量的利润。
words.en: Something that is substantial is large in size, amount, or importance.

words.tr:
n. 媒介；方法；
adj. 中等的；适中的；
words.ex: TV is a popular medium for advertising.
words.ex_cn: 电视是一种流行的广告媒介。
words.en: A medium is a method or way of expressing something.

words.ex: He dominates the conversation.
words.ex_cn: 他主宰了谈话。
words.en: To dominate means to control or govern someone or something, or to be the most important or noticeable feature of something.

words.tr:
v. 补充；
n. 补充物；附加费；
words.ex: He supplements his income by teaching part-time.
words.ex_cn: 他通过兼职教学来补充收入。
words.en: A supplement is something that is added to something else in order to make it complete or better.

words.ex: The fence marks the boundary between the two gardens.
words.ex_cn: 这道围栏标志着两个花园的分界线。
words.en: A boundary is a real or imagined line that marks the edge or limit of something.

words.ex: The team works in harmony.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队合作得很和谐。
words.en: Harmony is the pleasant combination of different notes of music played at the same time. It can also refer to a situation in which people are peaceful and agree with each other, or when things seem right or suitable together.

words.tr: phrase. 与...协调一致；与...和谐
words.ex: The painting is in harmony with the room's colors.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画与房间的颜色相协调。
words.en: If one thing is in harmony with another, the first thing suits the second or they seem right together.

words.ex: The children are playing in their natural surroundings.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在他们的自然环境中玩耍。
words.en: The things and conditions around a person, place, or thing.

words.ex: He stood in the midst of the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他站在人群中间。
words.en: The middle part or point of something.

words.tr: phrase. 在……之中；在……当中；正当……的时候
words.ex: He is running in the midst of the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他在人群中奔跑。
words.en: If you are in the midst of doing something, you are doing it at the moment.

words.tr: n. 棋盘；西洋跳棋棋盘; vt. 在……上面纵横交错地排列
words.ex: He placed the red piece on the black square of the checkerboard.
words.ex_cn: 他把红色的棋子放在了棋盘的黑色方格上。
words.en: A board marked with 64 squares, arranged in eight vertical and eight horizontal rows, on which the game of chess or checkers is played.

words.ex: The city became prosperous after the new factory opened.
words.ex_cn: 新工厂开业后，这座城市变得繁荣了。
words.en: A prosperous person, place, or economy is rich and successful.

words.ex: The children played on the hillside after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在山坡上玩耍。
words.en: The side of a hill.

words.ex: He walks in the orchard every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在果园里散步。
words.en: An orchard is an area of land where fruit trees are grown.

words.ex: The roses are in bloom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 玫瑰在春天开花。
words.en: When a plant or tree blooms, it produces flowers. The period during which a plant or tree produces flowers is also known as its bloom.

words.tr: 短语动词. 进入开花期；开始绽放（通常指植物）
words.ex: The flowers come into bloom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 花朵在春天开放。
words.en: When a plant or tree comes into bloom, it produces flowers.

words.ex: The oak tree stands tall in the backyard.
words.ex_cn: 栎树矗立在后院。
words.en: An oak is a large tree that is common in northern countries. Oaks have strong wood and are often used for making furniture.

words.ex: The maple leaves turn red in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 枫树的叶子在秋天变红。
words.en: A maple is a tree or shrub with lobed leaves, winged fruits, and colorful autumn foliage, which is often cultivated for its sap, wood, or ornamental value.

words.ex: The birch trees have white bark.
words.ex_cn: 桦树有白色的树皮。
words.en: A birch is a type of tree with thin branches and a smooth trunk, which is often white or silver in color.

words.tr:
n. 烈火；火焰；闪耀
v. 闪耀；熊熊燃烧；发亮光
words.ex: The fire began to blaze in the woods.
words.ex_cn: 火在森林里开始猛烈燃烧。
words.en: A blaze is a very large or fiercely burning fire that is difficult to control.

words.tr:
n. 火焰
v. 燃烧；爆发；面红
words.ex: The candle flame flickered in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛的火焰在风中摇曳。
words.en: A flame is a hot bright stream of burning gas that comes from something that is burning.

words.ex: The candle's flicker lit up the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛的闪现照亮了黑暗的房间。
words.en: If a light or flame flickers, it shines unsteadily.

words.ex: The actors stood in front of the backdrop with a mountain scene.
words.ex_cn: 演员们站在有山景的背景幕布前。
words.en: A backdrop is a large piece of cloth, often with scenery or buildings painted on it, that is hung at the back of a stage in a theatre.

words.ex: The pine grows tall in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 松树在森林里长得很高。
words.en: A pine is a type of evergreen tree which has long thin leaves called needles and produces cones. As a verb, to pine means to feel a deep longing or desire for something or someone.

words.tr:
n. 树皮；
v. 狗吠；
words.ex: The dog climbed the tree and touched the bark.
words.ex_cn: 狗爬上了树，摸了摸树皮。
words.en: The sound a dog makes; the outer covering of a tree.

words.ex: There was a thin mist over the lake at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 黎明时分，湖面上有一层薄雾。
words.en: Mist is a thin layer of cloud that touches the ground. It is less dense than fog and can make it difficult to see clearly.

words.ex: He wore a laurel crown on his head.
words.ex_cn: 他头上戴着月桂花环。
words.en: A laurel is a type of shrub or tree, specifically the bay tree, whose leaves are used in cooking and as a symbol of victory or honor.

words.ex: The viburnum blooms in spring with white flowers.
words.ex_cn: 荚蒾在春天开出白色花朵。
words.en: Any of various shrubs or small trees of the genus Viburnum, having opposite leaves and clusters of usually white flowers.

words.ex: The alder tree grows near the river.
words.ex_cn: 桤木长在河边。
words.en: An alder is a type of tree that grows in wet areas and has catkins and toothed leaves.

words.ex: The fern grows near the wet rock.
words.ex_cn: 蕨类植物长在潮湿的石头旁边。
words.en: A fern is a plant that has long stems with feathery or leafy fronds and reproduces by means of spores.

words.ex: Wolves feed on deer in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 狼在森林里以鹿为食。
